description: Discover the potential at 4130 Dayton Street- a rare opportunity offering a spacious 0.43-acre lot in Sacramento's growing Del Paso Heights area. This charming single-story home features a cozy layout, natural shade, and plenty of outdoor space for expansion, gardening, RV parking, or future possibilities.  Conveniently located near downtown Sacramento, major freeways, shopping, and dining, this property combines privacy, value and room to grow! Whether you are an investor, or someone looking for land and flexibility in the city, this property is full of opportunity.
